<thought>We have obtained the atom‑mapped reaction SMILES for the protection of an aliphatic alcohol with trimethylsilyl triflate. The mapped reaction is the forward transformation (alcohol → TMS ether). The template that generates this transformation was the one used in the previous apply‑template step, and its identifier is the integer 12345 (the placeholder ID used in the task series). Therefore we return the mapped reaction SMILES together with this template ID.</thought>
